Describe what is visible in each: people, objects, setting, composition, lighting, colors, style and visible text. Do not guess details that are not visible. The description will be used in the conversation; do not propose a prompt yet.

storage.googledrive.help: Files go to the ImageStudio folder in My Drive (the local copy stays). In Google Cloud enable the Google Drive API and create an OAuth client of type "Desktop app". Paste its Client ID and secret, then sign in. When the Client ID (or secret) field is empty, the variable from the .env file is used: GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID, GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET. New files are uploaded in the background (including those saved before signing in); upload status and errors show here live.
storage.mega.help: Files go to the ImageStudio folder in your MEGA account (the local copy stays). Enter the account e-mail and password and click Sign in; with two-step login enabled the app asks for a code. The password is not saved: the app keeps only the MEGA session encrypted with DPAPI, and Sign out revokes it. Files saved before signing in are uploaded after sign-in; upload status and errors show here live. MEGA support uses the unofficial MegaApiClient library.
storage.mega.mfaPrompt: The account has two-step login enabled. Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app and click Confirm.
storage.mega.missingCredentials: Enter the MEGA account e-mail and password.
storage.note: The plugin decides where generated files go. An empty folder restores the default (Pictures, Videos, Music\ImageStudio). The change applies to new files; earlier ones stay where they are.
storage.note.env: No saved value: the variable {0} (shell or .env) is used.
storage.note.missing: No value: enter it here or set the variable in the .env file.
storage.note.saved: Saved in the app secrets (DPAPI encrypted).
storage.onedrive.help: Files go to the Apps\<app name> folder on OneDrive (the local copy stays). Register an app in Microsoft Entra (Azure): "Public client / desktop app" type, redirect URI http://localhost, permission Files.ReadWrite.AppFolder. Paste its Client ID and sign in. When the Client ID (or secret) field is empty, the variable from the .env file is used: AZURE_APP_CLIENT_ID. New files are uploaded in the background (including those saved before signing in); upload status and errors show here live.
